final: WITH c AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.actor_id, c.n, 1.0*c.n/t.total AS share FROM c JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s) SELECT s.actor_id, s.n, s.share, s.share - a.av AS diff FROM s JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
